sql:
SELECT
    p.PromotionCategory,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) AS total_discount_amount,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) * 100.0 / nullif(sum(sum(f.DiscountAmount)) OVER (), 0) AS pct_of_all_discounts
FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  AND f.PromotionKey != 1
GROUP BY p.PromotionCategory
ORDER BY total_discount_amount DESC
